title: Daily close
subtitle: The close is automatic: each business day runs from one day's cutoff time to the next, and a day already lived does not change: whatever is voided or returned later counts on the day it happens. Expected cash = cash sales and payments + deposits − drawer expenses − withdrawals − cash refunds.
empty: There are no business days in this period.

expected.label: Expected cash
expected.formula: {{cashSales}} cash sales + {{cashCollected}} cash payments + {{deposits}} cash in − {{drawerExpenses}} drawer expenses − {{withdrawals}} withdrawals = {{total}}
expected.adjustments: Also today: − {{cashRefunds}} refunded in cash − {{priorCash}} from voided sales of earlier days {{later}} from voids of earlier days.
